Please read the instructions carefully before starting the Mock Test:

  1. Strict Countdown Timer: The total duration of this test is calculated strictly at 36 seconds per question (e.g., 15 minutes for 25 questions). The countdown timer in the top-right corner displays the remaining time. When the timer reaches zero, the examination will submit automatically.
  2. Question & Option Format: Each question has 4 options. The options are randomized on every test load/refresh, while the question sequence remains fixed. Only one question is displayed on the screen at a time.
  3. No Auto-Jump or In-Test Hints: Selecting an option does not reveal the answer and does not jump to the next question automatically. Click Save & Next (Next) or Mark for Review & Next to save your response and move forward.
  4. Question Number Palette (Right Side): The right-side scrollable question palette shows the status of each question using the standard TCS / Eduquity symbols below (hidden on mobile screens):
1 Not Visited: You have not visited the question yet.
2 Not Answered: You have visited the question but have not answered it.
3 Answered: You have answered the question (will be evaluated for +2 / -0.5 marks).
4 Marked for Review: You have NOT answered the question, but have marked it for review.
5 Answered & Marked for Review: Your selected answer WILL be evaluated unless cleared.

Post-Submission Analysis & Solutions:

  • Upon submission, your score, accuracy, and attempt breakdown are saved automatically in browser localStorage.
  • Detailed answers and explanations are displayed strictly for Incorrect and Unattempted questions on the submission review screen.
  • Clicking Start Mock Test will automatically enter Fullscreen Mode. You can exit fullscreen at any time using the Exit Fullscreen button.
